title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Who could the guests be...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You will soon see when they take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, allow us to introduce them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The band of virtuoso minstrels who are here just for you, Princess.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our special guests are this group!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, Princess!
We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're here with your band, Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
After we heard about this party from Tsukasa, we told him we wanted to be here to celebrate.
So—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This band of virtuoso minstrels will be singing you a birthday song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we're just a regular band...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? But you are virtuosos, are you not?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For your birthday present, Otori, we're going to perform a song for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're going to celebrate by playing with everything we have, so we hope you like what you hear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys☆
That was an amazingly wonderful song!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
My chest feels tight with joy right now.
And really warm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I heard your message loud and clear!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're glad that you enjoyed it so much, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Inviting them as special guests was the right call.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Emu looks so happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmm, after hearing them sing, I feel like singing something too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we all sing together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
After all, Emu, it is your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Feel free to tell us everything you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, then I wanna sing with everybody here!
All four of us, and the whole band too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, we'll play whatever you want.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Also, be sure to think of what we're going to do after we've finished singing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! Let us enjoy this party until the very end and celebrate with everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, let's begin! One, two, three—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone's smiling from ear to ear.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I get to be surrounded by yummy snacks and sing with everyone. Things are really, really fun already...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But I want to keep having even more fun with them☆)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho told us about how she and the others put on celebratory shows at your party!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're also gonna do a show for you!
We promise to give our performance everything we have, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. Um, in your words, that'd be... We're gonna put on a really wonderhoy show for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to doing our show. And happy birthday, Otori. I hope this upcoming year goes wonderfully for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... H-Happy birthday, Princess Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why are you calling her that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They apparently did a show during her birthday party! We heard that Otori became a princess, so we're gonna celebrate her like one too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. Then, I'll join in.
Happy birthday, Princess Emu.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, I'm just gonna say it normally...
Happy birthday, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Mafuyu & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's amazing how you got to play a princess during that show, Otori. I'm glad that you enjoyed yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, I came up with the design for that tiara at Rui's request♪ I hope you liked it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have a feeling you did, since you wore it for that photo. That lovely smile of yours made it clear just how happy you felt.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I hope we get a chance to celebrate together sometime. I really wanna talk to you again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Emu!
Did you have fun during our show? We were like a band of virtuoso minstrels, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we were just a regular band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I am glad that we got to celebrate by playing for you in person.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were more motivated than usual during our performance. Singing with you so much and seeing your big smile made me really happy, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's hard not to smile when she does. I hope we get to keep seeing that beautiful smile.
Once again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Our surprise birthday show was a rousing success. I did an excellent job as her servant, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Says the person who didn't know how he was going to play that role until the very last minute...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He probably just wanted to celebrate with all his might, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In the end, we were able to grant Emu's wish for a party that everyone could enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it's only fitting for Emu to be surrounded by smiling faces.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the way everybody there smiled really made it feel like a birthday party for Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope we keep making lots of people smile as we chase after our dreams together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you all so very much for celebrating my birthday like this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But what made me the happiest was the way you all smiled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know it's gonna be really hard to make everyone around the world smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I wanna work towards making my dream come true by learning how to do lots and lots and lots of different things! So—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm gonna keep moving forward with the others♪
Anyway, bye bye!
